summary.zh: check 能读取 latest.json 的迁移窗口：落后很多版本时按需取全量迁移说明，取不到时明确提示并按可能不兼容处理；不兼容步骤缺摘要时不再显示 None。
summary.en: check reads the latest.json migration window: when far behind it fetches the full migration notes, and when they are unavailable it says so and treats the update as possibly incompatible; a breaking step without a summary no longer shows None.
